name: Cape Cod & the Islands
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is warm, crowded, and expensive, especially on the islands; spring and fall bring quieter beaches and the best whale-watching.
overview: Cape Cod's lighthouses and clam shacks, paired with the genteel resorts of Martha's Vineyard and Nantucket — quintessential New England summer sailing.
costOverview: Clam shacks and casual seafood are reasonable on the mainland Cape — Nantucket and Martha's Vineyard run noticeably more expensive, especially for lodging.
